findings.problem: The existing LRECL criterion that Req 37 narrows still carries prohibited Unicode <= / >= glyphs (pre-existing, not authored by this gate). Req 37 narrows it by note rather than editing in place.
findings.fix: At implementation (author decision 1), when AC 10 is edited to scope it to RECFM F/FB/V/VB, also replace the two Unicode glyphs with ASCII '<=' / '>='. Not blocking: glyphs predate this CR and the narrowing is unambiguous.

findings.problem: 'per-member content type where member-level metadata exists' leaves the per-member storage path semi-specified.
findings.fix: When Requirement 8 member storage is implemented, record whether per-member content-type is stored or derived-only. Design already states the dataset-level LibraryKind-derived default governs in the interim, which is sufficient for the gate.

findings.problem: The primitive takes 'catalog: &impl CatalogQuery' but CatalogQuery is named as the 'existing catalog query surface' without a definition reference.
findings.fix: At implementation, confirm the concrete trait/type name (or introduce the minimal query trait) and cite it. The shape is marked 'final signatures in implementation', so this is a NIT.
